sections.title: Identification and cultivation
sections.text: This entry represents cultivated Asian rice, Oryza sativa, rather than the whole genus Oryza. This annual grass often exceeds 1 m; some deepwater rice forms can have stems several metres long.

sections.title: Panicle and grain
sections.text: The panicle bears spikelets. The rice grain eaten is the caryopsis, enclosed by the lemma and palea that form the husk; the dehulled grain is shown separately in the plate.

sections.title: Food
sections.text: The rice caryopsis is a staple food in many regions. Do not confuse Asian rice, O. sativa, with cultivated African rice, O. glaberrima.
